d.t: BEARER HOLDER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED DECKING FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Bearer Holder is an accessory used to connect timber joists to the pedestal for receiving decking boards. Bearer holders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has two wings to allow screwing into a timber joist giving it self-centering capabilities for increased stability. This bearer holder can accommodate joist widths of 35 mm to 80 mm. SikaRoof VersiJack Bearer Holder is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and timber joists, and is installed between the pedestal and the joists with the timber screws.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Bearer holder for raised decking installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
